title: Production integration acceptance
scope_items: Database Migration 00025: Created creator_progress, achievement_definitions, achievement_records, challenge_definitions, and challenge_progress tables per database_schema.md §14.1, §14.2, §22.10, §22.11 with composite tenant foreign keys to workspaces, ENABLE and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, exact integer/numeric fields without REAL/FLOAT (DB-H-001), restricted role grants to app_user and admin_user, canonical initial seed achievements, and reversible 25-step Down rollback.

Acceptance Target 1 (All four production modes exercised): End-to-end integration verified across Mode 1 Quick Edit (ASR engine, cut interval parsing, and draft saving), Mode 2 Clip Factory (1->N split, aspect ratio conversion, and viral CTA packaging), Mode 3 Multi-Merge (multi-track composition, auto-transitions, and SAFE-2026-02 unlicensed copyright enforcement), and Mode 4 AI Remix Studio (reference URL/DRM detection, Creative DNA extraction, and <30% originality threshold enforcement).

Acceptance Target 2 (Core and EF01-07 extended features exercised): Validated EF01 Product Showcase (8 styles including 360-degree spin and tabletop demo), EF02 Image-to-Video (motion styles, loop friendly, duration bounds), EF03 Link-to-Video (Shopee/Lazada scraping, script templates, SSRF protection), EF04 AI Thumbnails (5-factor mathematical CTR scoring and emotion templates), EF05 Dubbing & Translation (multilingual localization, lip-sync alignment, -14 LUFS loudness), EF06 Sound & Voice Clone (likeness consent requirements and consent withdrawal blocking), and EF07 Style Learning & Continuity (character pack extraction, consistency scoring, and continuity drift detection).

Acceptance Target 3 (Trend-to-remix lineage persistence & durable gamification hooks): Seamless data handoff from Trend Radar (M02) to Remix Studio (M07) via trend_id preservation in Protobuf, RemixBlueprint, and Asset.LineageRefs. Emitted canonical domain events (production.remix.analysis_started, production.remix.generation_completed, remix.completed) with trend_id. Integrated GamificationHook tracking streak progression (reset to 1 on missed day per AC-GAMIF-001), XP accumulation, Level calculation, achievement unlocking (remix_pioneer, first_video_generated), and idempotent credit reward deposits (RULE-GAM-007, RULE-GAM-008).

Acceptance Target 4 (Provider route evidence and honest disabled path): Verified Veo primary provider failure triggering automatic failover to Kling without double-debiting (quoted 80 credits deducted exactly once). Implemented and verified honest disabled path (PENDING_PRODUCTION_KEY) when external production credentials are unset, without fabricating cloud API responses.
Acceptance Target 5 (Future scopes retained): Preserved forward hooks and event signatures for P5-05 Creative Director Coaching and P7-04 Autonomous Video Agent without regressions.
verified_sub_slices: Go Integration Suite Verified: TestP409_AcceptanceTarget1_AllFourProductionModes, TestP409_AcceptanceTarget2_CoreAndEF01to07ExtendedFeatures, TestP409_AcceptanceTarget3_TrendToRemixLineageAndGamificationHooks, TestP409_AcceptanceTarget4_ProviderRoutingAndHonestDisabledPath, and TestP409_AcceptanceTarget5_FutureScopesRetained all pass with Go thread race detector enabled.
Migration 00025 Verified: TestMigrator_AllMigrationsPass verifies all 25 migrations Up, Status, and clean Down transactional rollback.

Proto 4-Target Generation Verified: tooling/proto-gen.sh generate and verify pass Buf lint, codegen across Go, TypeScript, and Dart, git drift check, TS compilation, and Dart analyze with zero errors.
Web Frontend Verified: apps/web check (0 errors, 0 warnings), vitest (26 test files, 204 tests passed including trend_to_remix tests), vite build, and real SvelteKit SSR smoke pass cleanly.

Mobile Flutter Verified: apps/mobile flutter analyze (0 issues found) and flutter test (178 unit/acceptance tests passed including production_integration_acceptance_test.dart) pass with zero failures.
external_gates: Live Veo 2.0 and Kling AI video studio pipelines require external cloud provider credentials and active production billing accounts. Deterministic routing, provider failover (Veo -> Kling), zero double-debiting, and honest unconfigured paths verified locally.

Migration 00025 schema, composite foreign keys, RLS policies (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), and narrow role grants verified via local migrator test; live multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS suite executes in CI harness.

decisions: ADR-P4-09-001: Preserved trend_id in Protobuf LineageItem, RemixBlueprint, and RemixServiceAnalyzeRequest to guarantee traceable data lineage from Trend Radar to Remix Studio.
ADR-P4-09-002: GamificationHook enforces consecutive daily activity tracking, resetting streak_days to 1 on a missed day (AC-GAMIF-001), while preserving longest_streak.
ADR-P4-09-003: AutoDepositCredits toggle in GamificationHook enables automatic crediting of achievement rewards (RULE-GAM-007) while maintaining isolated unit test reproducibility.
ADR-P4-09-004: Veo to Kling provider fallback deducts estimated credits exactly once (zero double charge), recording the successful fallback provider in the asset lineage.
ADR-P4-09-005: Unconfigured production providers return honest disabled status (PENDING_PRODUCTION_KEY) rather than mocking live external cloud responses.
